data.title: 爱宕 · 晨光被单间的极尽宠溺
data.description: 假日清晨凌乱的白床单上黑发如瀑铺展。爱宕跨坐在身前，汗湿的犬耳轻快摇晃，眼眸迷离含泪，在无休止的炙热喘息与颠簸中娇吟索吻，给予你至死不渝的全部宠爱。
data.location: sun-drenched morning bedroom with soft white linen
data.action: lying amidst rumpled white bedsheets, long black hair spread out, breathless and smiling blissfully while straddling partner, dog tail wagging gently in ecstasy
data.lighting: golden morning sunlight streaming across tangled white bedding
data.mood: ecstatic devotion, blissful morning heat, deep sensual communion
data.promptProse: Straddling partner amidst rumpled white sheets in golden morning light, Atago smiles ecstatically with flushed cheeks and breathless moans.
data.animaCaption: Atago straddling passionately on a messy morning bed amidst sunlight.
